copilot-adapter-kit.config.title: Copilot Adapter Kit (CAK)
copilot-adapter-kit.config.maxTokens: Max output tokens per request. `0` uses the model’s declared maximum. The Spend Guard always applies its own ceiling on top of this — output is never unbounded.
copilot-adapter-kit.config.stabilizeTool:
Experimental: lock tool configurations to improve cache hit rates. Pre-activates all available VS Code tools so the tools array stays identical across turns — each subsequent request reuses cached context. 

⚠️ Requests include more function definitions — input tokens increase. Cached tokens are cheaper but still count toward usage. 

- 64 or fewer enabled tools: usually stable — leave this off. 
- More than 128 tools: not supported. Disable unused tools. 
- May inject internal activation calls into chat history. Start a new chat if switching models behaves unexpectedly. 

Use Configure Tools (workbench.action.chat.configureTools) to manage your tool list.
copilot-adapter-kit.config.logLevel: quiet = token counts | meta = hashes + cache trace | dump = full request payloads
copilot-adapter-kit.config.visionFallbac: Model ID to use for vision/image description when the selected model doesn't support images. Leave empty to disable. Format: family:modelId (e.g. openai:gpt-5.2) or just modelId.
If enabled, always preprocess image input through the configured vision fallback model when one is set. Recommended for providers that reject image parts.
copilot-adapter-kit.config.systemPrompt: Custom system prompt template. Supports placeholders: {model}, {date}, {tools}, {cakVersion}. Leave empty to use Copilot's default. Example: "You are {model}, a helpful coding assistant. Today is {date}."
copilot-adapter-kit.config.gitPrompt: Custom Git commit message generation prompt. Supports placeholders: {diff}, {branch}, {repo}. Invoked from the Tools tab to generate conventional commit messages via the configured LLM.
copilot-adapter-kit.config.maxDiffFiles: Max number of changed files before diff is compressed to --stat/--numstat summary (avoids LLM context window limits). Default: 500.
copilot-adapter-kit.command.generateComm: Copilot Adapter Kit: Generate Git Commit Message
copilot-adapter-kit.config.models: Add custom models. Each entry needs id and family. Matches providers by family name.
copilot-adapter-kit.config.hiddenBuiltin: Specific built-in model IDs to hide from the picker. Use the Open Panel UI to manage this visually.
copilot-adapter-kit.config.modelOverride: Per-model overrides (name, maxIn, maxOut, etc.) for built-in models. Managed via the panel UI.
copilot-adapter-kit.command.showUsage: Copilot Adapter Kit: Show Token Usage
copilot-adapter-kit.command.resetBudget: Copilot Adapter Kit: Reset Today's Usage
copilot-adapter-kit.command.disableSpend: Copilot Adapter Kit: Disable Spend Guard (Dangerous)
copilot-adapter-kit.command.enableSpendG: Copilot Adapter Kit: Enable Spend Guard
copilot-adapter-kit.config.budget.enforc: **Spend guard.** When on (default), requests that would exceed the limits below are blocked before they are sent. Turning this off removes ALL spend protection — an agent loop can then run unbounded.
copilot-adapter-kit.config.budget.dailyT: Maximum total tokens (input + output) per calendar day, across all providers. `0` disables the token limit.
copilot-adapter-kit.config.budget.dailyC: Maximum estimated spend in USD per calendar day, computed from each model’s configured pricing. Models without pricing contribute $0. `0` disables the cost limit.
copilot-adapter-kit.config.budget.maxInp: Reject any single request whose estimated input exceeds this many tokens. `0` disables the check.
copilot-adapter-kit.config.budget.maxOut: Hard ceiling on `max_tokens` for every request. `0` uses the model’s declared max output (never unlimited).
copilot-adapter-kit.config.budget.maxTur: Agent loop guard — maximum requests for one conversation before further turns are refused. `0` disables the guard.
